title: The gaming king, period
body: Dropped from a 5800X3D, +22% avg FPS in sims and strategy titles that punish everything else. Runs on a $25 tower cooler.

title: Perfect for games, meh for renders
body: If you also render, the 12-thread handicap is real. Pure gamers: buy without thinking.

title: Price finally makes sense
body: Street price fell under the 7700X. No-brainer now.

title: Still the value legend
body: Handles 1080p gaming with a 3060 Ti no problem, sips power, silent on stock cooler. Unbeatable used.

title: Great, but platform is dead
body: Chip is flawless for the price; just know LGA1700 has no upgrade path left.

title: The 1440p default choice
body: Matches last-gen 3090 raster for $300 less and 100W lower. DLSS3 FG extends its life easily.

title: Get a good AIB model
body: FE is fine but partner cards run 8°C cooler. 12GB will age faster than 16GB rivals though.

title: 16GB changes everything
body: Texture settings I skip on my old 10GB card just... work. Raster beats 4070 non-Super outright.

title: AV1 and RT lag hurts
body: Great card for pure gaming; creators still belong on NVIDIA. FSR4 closed the upscale gap some.

title: Workstation in a desktop socket
body: Blender Classroom in 2m14s. Undervolted to 120W it loses only 4%. Magic.

title: Hot by design
body: You WILL hit 95°C by default. Fine if you understand PBO limits, annoying otherwise.

title: Absurd in the best way
body: 4K/144 path-traced everything. The 24GB buffer is holding up shockingly well.

title: Plan your case around it
body: It fits exactly one case I own. Measure twice.

title: 20 cores for $360
body: Productivity punches far above price; gaming within 5% of i9. Needs serious cooling.

title: The AM4 forever chip
body: Six years old, still carries a 3060 Ti at 1080p perfectly. $95 used is criminal value.

title: 12GB saved it
body: The card that refuses to die thanks to VRAM. Driver support continues strong.

title: Replaced our dual Xeon
body: Half the power, double the single-thread. TRX50 platform finally delivers.

title: Battery champion
body: Meteor Lake iGPU is genuinely usable for light editing; 12h mixed-use runtime in our testing.
